'''Gungi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He could not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], but was able to understand the language and communicate with others by speaking [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], Gungi was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Order's members were forced to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As the war was waged around them, Gungi was deemed to be one of the top members of his [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] and suitable to travel to the sacred Jedi world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to participate in the ancient ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]]. Escorted to Ilum by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Gungi and several other Initiates met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Temple]] at the mouth of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]].<ref name="TCW:TG" />

[[File:Gungi-Crystal_Caves.png|thumb|left|240px|Gungi locating his lightsaber crystal across the subterranean lake within the Crystal Caves.]]
Entering into the caves in search of a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] for use in his personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Gungi was accompanied by fellow Initiate [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] as he searched the labyrinthine caves. Coming across a massive subterranean lake, Gungi was confident that his crystal lay on a frozen island in the midst of the lake. In order to cross the water, Gungi would have to wait for the lake to freeze over as the sun set. Testing all of his patience, Gungi went into [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] by the lake's edge and was able to remain calm until the surface of the lake was frozen over. Traversing the lake, Gungi claimed the crystal and made it back out of the caves to await the other Initiates in the Temple. Master Yoda commended him on being patient.<ref name="TCW:TG" />

Returning to the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], Gungi constructed a [[Gungi's lightsaber/Legends|green-bladed lightsaber]] and chose the wood of a [[Brylark tree/Legends|Brylark tree]], which was as strong as metal, for the hilt.<ref name="ATOS" />

After landing on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], he participated in the [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|rescue]] of Tano from the clutches of Weequay pirate leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], after he had captured her during the raid on their ship. After freeing Tano, he and his fellow initiates attempted to escape but were foiled by two of the pirates. However, the Jedi and the pirates soon formed a temporary alliance when the system fell into control of the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The young Jedi freed Hondo and the rest of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] and attempted to escape using a ship from Hondo's personal hidden fleet, with the cyborg general hot on their trail. After a brief duel between Tano and Grievous, they succeeded in escaping and rendezvoused with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s heavily damaged fleet.

==Personality and traits==
Gungi was very lively and outgoing, but was also somewhat impatient. In order to reach his lightsaber crystal, Gungi was forced to calm down and wait patiently for the ice to freeze enough for him to reach it, learning the virtue of patience.

He was brave and loyal, standing by his friends, rescuing Ahsoka from Hondo, and willingly raised his lightsaber towards the droid general, Grievous a well known Jedi hunter.

==Powers and abilities==
Gungi was a young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] and one of the top in his class. He could use the Force to enhance his athletic skills, and was strong enough to hold his fellow Initiates during an "audition" to join a traveling circus. He used the Force to calm himself in order to be patient enough to bypass the obstacle to his lightsaber crystal. He was able to use [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] being able to make his own lightsaber. He was also capable with a lightsaber, being able to take down several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
